children: Stocks will continue to trade erratically, Bank of America analysts write. Dispersion--or the difference in performance between stocks--is the defining theme in U.S. stocks, the analysts write. Uncertainty over the regulatory environment surrounding artificial intelligence will lead to sharp differences in returns from various corners of the stock market, the analysts write. Investors' constant re-evaluation of the future will drive volatility and they should therefore position to benefit from dispersion, the analysts say. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
